metadata.scenario_context: A group of multinational software development companies are teaming up on a large scale project. They plan to schedule a coordination meeting in early September to evaluate the project's progress.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from United States agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose to hold the coordination meeting on September 7th.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to have the army rule.
